verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing states it sends Slack, Discord, or email notifications when user-specified conditions are met, which covers the chat/email alerting story as written. The evidence is a single homepage line with no detailed documentation of how alerts are configured. missing for 10: in-depth docs on alert condition types and setup (thresholds, metrics, routing), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met

citations.quote: Slack, Discord, or emails the moment conditions you specify are met.
